amendmentReason: The GitHub connector path does not provide an authenticated workflow-dispatch operation and connector-created commits may not trigger Actions deterministically. Before any E1 performance outcome was computed, the development transport was upgraded from the keyless Yahoo proxy to the connected Massive market-data authority and immutable provider extracts will be staged in-repository. This removes opaque continuous-futures development proxies from E1 and improves provenance.

transportSmokeTestsOnly: AAPL hourly connectivity sample in September 2026
two-day January 2025 transport samples for EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, XAUUSD, XAGUSD, BTCUSD, ETHUSD and NDX

provider.name: Massive
provider.extractPolicy: Hourly OHLC extracts are requested in fixed calendar chunks, normalized, checksummed and committed as immutable E1 development inputs.
provider.failedInstrumentRule: Fail the affected block closed; no post-outcome symbol substitution.

timeframes.fourHourAggregation: UTC-anchored exact groups of four source bars; incomplete groups are discarded.
timeframes.smallTimeframeBoundary: 15m remains sealed from E1 because a clean long multi-market development extract has not yet been frozen. It will be a separate transport/timeframe program after core component viability.

explicitlyDeferredFamilies.futures: Deferred from E1 until a point-in-time contract chain and causal roll/back-adjustment protocol is locked using Massive futures contract metadata. Opaque vendor continuous contracts are prohibited.
explicitlyDeferredFamilies.energyCommodities: Deferred with futures. This does not authorize treating an ETF proxy as the underlying futures market.

dataSemantics.FX: Massive forex aggregates are derived from bid/ask quote updates rather than executed trades.
dataSemantics.METALS_SPOT: XAUUSD/XAGUSD are handled as quote-aggregate spot/OTC-style instruments under the FX transport semantics.
dataSemantics.INDEX: Index bars represent index values and do not imply executable trade prints.
dataSemantics.EQUITY: Stock aggregates use adjusted=true for split normalization in development extracts.
dataSemantics.CRYPTO_SPOT: Crypto aggregates are trade-derived provider aggregates.

costDisclosure: Modeled one-way friction is a conservative Phase-1 ranking rail, not a broker-specific fill guarantee. Index results are signal-quality evidence only until mapped to an executable index instrument.

frozenComponents.candidateGenerator: BREAKOUT + PULLBACK + SWEEP_RECLAIM from ite1_core.py; no post-outcome setup deletion.

opportunityAudit.purpose: Audit/recall only; never a decision feature.

developmentDecisionRule.failureOutcome: No E1 threshold rescue. If no entry mode passes, S1/T1/M1 remain sealed and the candidate/setup architecture must be amended before another development run.

antiSelectionRules: No dropping losing instruments after outcomes.
No changing cost assumptions after gross results.
No treating NDX index values as directly executable fills.
dataFreezeRule: The SHA-256 of every staged provider extract must be recorded before E1 performance evaluation.
nextAuthorizedAction: Stage and checksum Massive hourly development extracts only, then execute E1 on the frozen data. Validation and holdout remain unopened.

bootstrap.method: hierarchical instrument-timeframe bootstrap with circular candidate blocks

dataFiles.namingRule: provider ticker mapped to filesystem-safe name plus _1h.csv
dataFiles.coverageGate: Every file must begin no later than 2024-11-02 UTC and extend through at least 2025-06-29 UTC. Provider warning/error text is a hard failure.
